title: Fail closed for Skill proposals without an execution boundary
goal: Prevent a Skill-bearing action proposal from being reported as executed until canonical Skill execution is wired.
context: PALOOP-5 carries Skill identity into ActionProposal; M6Orchestrator currently handles toolID but does not execute skillID, which could otherwise produce the default synthetic success observation.
forbidden_changes: Do not add PARuntime -> PASkills dependency.
Do not claim Skill integration is complete.
Do not change UI or bypass policy/approval.
acceptance_criteria: Skill proposals without an execution boundary produce an explicit failed observation with skillID.
No actionExecuted event is emitted for an unexecuted Skill.
Regression test asserts fail-closed behavior and terminal abort.
verification: Confirm CI M3, Agent Task Contract, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA.
recovery: Revert this task's single commit if the regression test or CI fails.
